text: The README is a front page for people, at most 400 lines: what Invariant is, its stories and graphics, the gate's checks, how to try it and use it, and its status, each slice's first sentence kept for the dashboard's road. Reference detail lives in pages under docs/ the README links, docs/gate.md, docs/python.md, docs/factory.md and docs/dashboard.md, which describe Invariant as it is under the same rule. A test holds the README to its budget and checks that every relative link and anchor in it and under docs/ resolves, and CI's What changed job runs it on every change, since the gate skips a change to docs alone. The planning and build prompts and AGENTS.md say so. @gitdek chose this shape on 2026-11-02, built by hand (#447).
